description: This source file defines an internal interface IPropertyDescription and a class PropertyDescription within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. The class models property descriptions for code generation purposes, encapsulating property metadata and providing utility methods for type syntax representation.

classes.name: PropertyDescription
classes.description: Represents a property with metadata including its type, symbol, and serialization attributes, used in code generation within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: PropertyDescription constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new PropertyDescription instance, setting properties like FieldId, whether it's a primary constructor parameter, and the associated property symbol. Also determines the type syntax based on the property type kind.

methods.name: GetTypeSyntax
methods.description: Returns the TypeSyntax representation for a given ITypeSymbol.
